in_hebrew.name: Ikkela
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ikkela הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'ikkilazo', meaning 'to fight'. In mythology, Ikkela was a warrior maiden who defended her people against invaders.
